reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that monitors local token usage and estimated costs, displays balance and billing-period information, and provides real-time rate and next-message cost forecasts.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中展示余额、令牌使用速率、计费时段、本地支出估算及下一条消息成本预测。
summaries.en: Displays balance, token usage rate, billing periods, local spending estimates, and next-message cost forecasts in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads local Harness session logs for token and cost usage
Displays balance, token rate, billing-period status, and spending estimates
Calculates model-aware pricing and next-message cost forecasts
Refreshes balance data through the host integration
Injects a monitoring card into the DeepSeek Harness web interface
